changes.message: Job priorities are now bound to your player
Job preferences on characters are "yes" or "no" like antag selection
Characters can be individually enabled or disabled
All enabled characters will be considered for round start job assignment (does not affect Antag before job roll)
Antag character previews are shown on character customization (if character has no job selected)
Late join window now has a character picker
You can make profiles for Space Ninja! (They will be used when ghost role is taken)
Show job specific loadout name on character pickers
Lobby character summary is overhauled to display all of your selected jobs and characters in a hopefully clean and intuitive way!
Age, species, and trait job requirements should now work with role timers turned off
Non-human species will no longer show up in the guidebook with a weirdly human skin tone...
Admin verb - "Spawn as ... " lets you spawn a player using any of their profiles.
You can drag and drop the icons in the lobby to change your job priorities!
Better user feedback (clear tooltips) for the "Ready/Not Ready" button.
